selection.candidate_policy: descriptive sources require positive navigation/look/stand labels; supplied official descriptions supersede filenames; only declared numeric datasets may remain explicit unknown kinematic candidates
selection.resampling: allselectedclips reconstruct currentneutralFK from root/localrotations and fresh30Hz forward/angular velocities; 50Hz uses actual shortestarcSLERP
selection.segmentation: max4/source; prefer250frame(8.3s)Diffwindows; nonoverlappingmediumclips/tails >=91frames(3s) may contributeAMP-only windows; windowsORwholeclip, neverboth; no repeatedtimeinterval/padding
selection.selection_order: navigation filename/officialdescription candidates first, then explicitlyunknown candidates; stable seeded round robin over style/dataset/subject namespaces
selection.expert_actions: next-frame mocap joint position mapped to normalized PD targets; no measured expert torques
selection.contact_quality: near-floor speed is a kinematic proxy, not measured contact or a hard filter
selection.heldout_policy: original validation/test clip IDs retained exactly
selection.dof_velocity_formula: axis_angle(q_t^-1 * q_(t+1))/dt; shortest rotation; finalframe carries previous velocity
